title: feat: introduce initialUiState option

comments.body: How does it behave when combined with routing on initial load with a state in the url?

> How does it behave when combined with routing on initial load with a state in the url?

Nothing is implemented right now since routing is not updated (yet). For a first version I think an override (or shallow merge) will be enough otherwise we have to implement a merge function for `UiState`. This is something that I would like to avoid as much as possible. Another alternative is to allow the user to provide its own function to perform the merge.

Any evidence this actually works in v4? Can't get it to work at all myself. No console errors, but also zero impact on results. Have followed the example at https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/instantsearch/js/#widget-param-initialuistate
Note that you need to mount a (could be virtual / non-rendering) widget too. We have a warning for that case normally, so I’d like to see your reproduction on codesandbox

Thanks, that seems to have done the job. I must say it does seem more difficult than using `searchParameters` from previous versions, so I'm not sure why that would be deprecated in favour of this, although I'm sure you guys have your reasons :) Cheers
I think you missed the first part of that note, saying the default replacement is the configure widget. I've updated the docs to be clearer by the way

I did miss that, my bad. Looking at the docs now...

https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/configure/js/
points me to:
https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/search-api-parameters/

There is no mention of "disjunctiveFacetsRefinements" as a possible parameter in the searchParameters object.
True, that’s also somewhat confusing. The arguments aren’t just search parameters, but also helper ones: https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/reference.html
